intro: You need to post a letter. Ask the officer where the post office is.

conversation.speaker: stranger
conversation.text: Yes? Do you need any help?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Politely ask where the post office is.
expected: Excuse me, where is the post office?
Could you tell me where the post office is?
Where is the post office, please?
conversation.hint: Try: "Excuse me, where is the post office?"

conversation.speaker: stranger
conversation.text: Go straight and take the second left. It is beside the bank.

conversation.speaker: student
expected: How far is the post office?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask if you can walk there or should take a bus.
expected: Is it better to walk or take a bus?

conversation.speaker: stranger
conversation.text: You can walk. It is a straight road.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Repeat the directions to make sure you understood.
expected: So I go straight and turn left.
Straight and then the second left, yes?
conversation.hint: Try: "So I go straight and turn left."

conversation.speaker: stranger
conversation.text: That is right. You will find it easily.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Thank the officer for the directions.
